testimonialsMainTitle: Organizations Interested in Working with PAG

testimonials.name: Governments and Public Institutions
testimonials.text: PAG welcomes collaboration with governments and public institutions seeking secure, reliable infrastructure systems across emerging markets.

testimonials.name: International Technology Companies
testimonials.text: Global technology providers can engage with PAG to support deployment of advanced systems into African institutional and national environments.

testimonials.name: Infrastructure Investors
testimonials.text: PAG works with infrastructure investors where institutional deployment requires structured coordination between capital, technology, and execution stakeholders.

testimonials.name: Engineering and Implementation Partners
testimonials.text: Regional engineering and implementation partners are welcome where long-term operational continuity and field delivery capability are required.
